originalObservation: Claude-hosted scope reservation rename returned EPERM before any provider submission. Same-id rerun recovered. The OS handle holder was not captured; no antivirus cause is asserted.
method: Real PowerShell FileStream opens the root with FileShare.Read and keeps it held until explicitly released. The old atomic overwrite exhausts its existing five-second retry window. Test readiness/release waits are bounded; no elevation, services or persistent tasks.

compatibility.method: Actual previous/current companions using null adapters and isolated temporary state. More metadata names, request-stage reads and flushes are explicit costs; model context/permissions and healthy framing are unchanged.
